studies.draft_uses: Cited as '[5] Lück S, Mohn A, Lamb WF. Frontiers in Climate. 2024.' studies.latest_known: Published 17 September 2024, Frontiers in Climate, vol. 6, doi:10.3389/fclim.2024.1425971. No correction, retraction, or superseding update to this paper has been identified as of November 2026.
studies.what_changed: No figures changed. Novel CDR remains ~0.002 GtCO2/yr (2 MtCO2/yr), consistent with the draft's figure. The paper itself has not been superseded, but the current-CDR headline figures it underpins have been revised upward in the 3rd SoCDR edition.

studies.name: State of Carbon Dioxide Removal (background data source for current CDR levels)
studies.draft_uses: Not cited directly, but the draft's figures for current total CDR (~2 GtCO2/yr, ~3% of net GHG emissions) and novel CDR (~2 MtCO2/yr) originate from the State of CDR 1st Edition (2023) and are reproduced via sources [4] and [5]. The draft's figure of ~2 MtCO2/yr for novel CDR and ~2 GtCO2/yr total are the 1st-edition figures.
studies.latest_known: 3rd Edition published 2 June 2026 (Edwards, Geden, Gidden, Lamb et al., doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/ZRD65). Key updated figures: total CDR = 2.2 GtCO2/yr (conventional 99.9% = ~2.2 GtCO2/yr; novel = ~0.002 GtCO2/yr = 2 MtCO2/yr). The '3% of net GHG emissions' framing has changed to '5% of gross CO2 emissions.' Novel CDR figure (2 MtCO2/yr) is unchanged. The 2nd Edition (2024) gave novel CDR as 1.3 MtCO2/yr (0.0013 GtCO2/yr); the 3rd Edition gives ~0.002 GtCO2/yr (2 MtCO2/yr), suggesting growth. The draft's '2 MtCO2/yr' for novel CDR is consistent with the 3rd Edition figure but not the 2nd Edition figure (1.3 MtCO2/yr).
studies.what_changed: Total CDR: draft says ~2 GtCO2/yr; 3rd Edition (June 2026) says 2.2 GtCO2/yr. Percentage framing: draft says ~3% of current global net GHG emissions; 3rd Edition says ~5% of gross CO2 emissions (different denominator, not directly comparable but the draft's framing is outdated). Novel CDR: draft says ~2 MtCO2/yr; 2nd Edition (2024) said 1.3 MtCO2/yr; 3rd Edition (2026) says ~2 MtCO2/yr — the draft's figure happens to match the 3rd Edition but not the 2nd Edition, suggesting the draft may be using an intermediate or rounded figure. Since the draft does not cite SoCDR directly, the supersession applies to the underlying data, not to the cited papers [4] and [5] themselves.
